FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id AND p.player_id = pim.player_id
WHERE m.season = '2019' 
AND pim.team_name = 'India'
AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field', 'handled the ball', 'timed out', 'hit the ball twice')
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY wickets DESC
LIMIT 1;
